Ceiling fan installation Perth: service scope

  • Investigate a ceiling fan not working, humming or responding inconsistently to controls.
  • Install or replace the agreed ceiling fan and assess its electrical and control requirements.
  • Check suitability of support and mounting rather than treating every movement as an electrical fault.
  • Structural alterations, ceiling repairs and incompatible controls need separate scope; not every fan or controller can be reused.

We confirm the property, installation and requested outcome before selecting the work. Fixed plumbing and electrical tasks are handled by the appropriate qualified trade; a coordinated visit does not make every task interchangeable. Current documentation relevant to the proposed work can be requested privately.

Ceiling Fan Installation & Repairs Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

  • Perth electrical services
  • Lighting and fan-light planning
  • Electrical fitting overview
  • Bathroom exhaust fans
  • Electrical supply faults
Why does a ceiling fan hum but not turn?

A motor, control or other fan fault may be involved, but the sound alone does not identify the part. Stop using a fan behaving abnormally and arrange assessment rather than dismantling it or forcing the blades.

Can a ceiling fan be repaired or should it be replaced?

That depends on the findings, parts availability and condition of the fan and controls. We explain the repair option and any proposed replacement before you approve the work.

Can a fan go where a ceiling light is now?

It may be possible, but mounting support, clearance, wiring and controls must be checked. An existing lighting connection does not by itself establish a suitable fan installation.

Can I supply my own ceiling fan?

Discuss the model before purchase. Confirm suitability, included controls, who supplies the product and any additional mounting or electrical work in the quote.
